notes.title: IPackThat removed from Store
notes.notes:
Hello folks,

seems like the activation procedure wasn't so good after all.
I currently implementing the direct steam api via steamworks.net.

I will upload a new version and check with steam if its valid this way.

After this change, you need to have the steam client installed so the tool can check if the app is valid.

This will be done in the background at the first start and after a version update.

No input is required now.

notes.title: Out of Early Access
notes.notes:
Hello folks,

we are finally released :)
Thanks to Tom Giardino from Valve ːsteamhappyː

All buyers who got IPackThat during early access also received automatically the commercial upgrade as free gift.

Short roadmap for upcoming updates

[list]
[*] Triangulate incoming uv shells
[list]
    [*] just internal for better handling all the math
    [*] triangles are far cheaper to operate with than ngons in undetermant sice (the area from ngons for examples is heavy math compared to triangle area)
    [*] have to change every math inside the tool ( but helps a lot for upcoming stuff )
[/list]
[*] move scene stats to viewport as overlay
[list]
    [*] can be toggled together with cpu and fps meter
[/list]
[*] ability to crunch down the outer contours
[list]
    [*] different settings for lowpoly outlines (low medium high)
    [*] faster checks but not accurate ( depending on the quality level )
[/list]
[/list]

Thats all for now, if you got suggestions or got problem support@IPackThat.com

notes.title: Update 1.7.5662.27030 - Current Early Access State
notes.notes:
Hello all,

a small drawback while try to leave early access. As giveaway for all who bought the tool during early access i give away the commercial upgrade version for free. Because of that i can't leave early access that easy. Have to get in contact with steam to make the transition.
The tool itself is finished so far and ready to leave early access. There are still feature request that will be handled after leaving early access.

in the meantime i uploaded a new update with some nice features people asked on  [url=http://www.polycount.com/forum/showthread.php?t=145328&page=24] Polycount [/url]

[list]
[*]added shortcuts for move, rotate and scale via keyboard input
[list]
[*]shift + arrow keys	move
[*]ctrl +up/down	scale
[*]ctrl left/right 	rotate
[/list]
[*]added shortcuts for handling groups
[list]
[*]1 – 0		select by group index
[*]ctrl  + 1 – 0		add group to selection (toggle the group selection)
[*]shift + 1 – 0		add selection to group 
[*]shift + g		add selection to new group 
[*]shift + c		clear group from selection 
[/list]
[*]added shortcuts for cycle cluster selection 
[list]
[*]arrow up 		select first cluster 
[*]arrow down		select last cluster 
[*]arrow left 		cycle backwards
[*]arrow right		cycle forward
[/list]
[*]enhanced group color generation to avoid default polygon fill color or colors from existing groups
[*]added mesh-file as new executing argument (usable for scripts or with the open with explorer extension)
[list]
[*]IpackThat.exe d:\foobar\thefoomesh.fbx
[/list]
[*]split by material id's on import is now working
[list]
[*]if a UV chunk contains multiple material id's, only the material id from the first polygon is used. To avoid this, split the UV chunk by material id ( the tool will not split or alter the UV point amount. Just the UV point locations)
[/list]
[*]group by material id as new context menu option
[*]updated documentation
[/list]

sorry for the delay 

happy weekend :)

notes.title: Update 1.7.5639.24912
notes.notes:
Hello together

next uand hopefully last update before i leave early access.
If within one week no more bad bugs are reported, the tool will go release :)
All open feature requests are not gone then. They will be implemented afterwards.

Bugs and feature requests can be reported to support@ipackthat.com
If you are interested in a bulk license mail, to license@ipackthat.com

here the update list
[list]
[*]properties and transformations enabled again on packed solution
[*]start packing now uses the current viewed UV-Layout (useful for iterative packing)
[list]
[*]fixes the rotation settings bug (reported by Malcolm on Polycount)
[/list]
[*]fixed a bug with negative bake or UV-Layout offsets 
[list]
[*]if treat as bake-offset they will be shifted x + 1 on save
[/list]
[*]fixed precision bug with contour detection
[list]
[*]contour where generated incorrect with merged clusters
[*]contours are now more precise ( very small holes are now present as well ) 
[/list]
[*]cluster property checkboxes now toggle thru true and false if selection is just 1
[*]more performance optimizations
[list]
[*]changed methods are now around twice as fast
[/list]
[*]find smallest bounds and rotation steps are now used for groups
[list]
[*]packed area did not used the properties from the group clusters
[*]if a single cluster inside a group can't rotate → resulting area can't rotate
[*]if a single cluster inside a group can't find smallest bounds → resulting area  can't find smallest bounds
[*]largest rotation step value of the group clusters are uses for the resulting area
[/list]
[*]removed lorem ipsum dummy inside info and disclaimer window and referencing the local EULA.txt


thanks for all the great feedback :)

notes.title: Direct2D Beta Branch
notes.notes:
Uploaded a new Beta Branched ( Direct2D )

I have started to change the viewport of IPackThat from old rendering to directd2d.
I had to do this step as the performance of the view screen where worser for every feature i added.
The new direct2d viewport is a lot faster now and can do things better than the old one.
[list]
[*]render outside  0 1 space
[*]faster access
[*]draw packing now can be panned and zoomed without messup
[*]zooming in/out is smoother and wont affect performance
[*]zooming in/out has no limits anymore
[/list]

If all went well i can enable the beta branch with some more fixes and tweaks by next monday.
This current new feature will be the last new feature before release.
When i have finished porting this feature, the tool will go out of early access.

notes.title: Short Notice
notes.notes:
Incoming patch at Monday 20.April.2015

To avoid very high update cycles i will upload a new patch (if available of course) every monday.

Short information about the login procedure. 
If you wonder about the seperate Login inside the tool, this is a native Steam Web Api login. That way the tool can also run without installed Steam-Client.
In the next patch i will add the Steam API button to clarify this behavior. 
The login credencials are not stored anywhere.
 After the activation, the tool wont ask again unless a new patch will be applied.
